subject: Startups
title: The 83(b) Election
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The 83(b) Election.

hook.text: A tax form you've never heard of could save you millions.

buildup.text: When founders receive restricted stock, the IRS taxes it as it vests. If the company grows, the tax bill grows too.

discovery.text: The 83(b) election lets you pay tax on the stock's value at grant date—usually near zero—instead of at vest.

twist.text: You must file within 30 days of receiving the stock. There's no extension.

climax.text: On paper, you might pay $100 in tax now instead of $1 million later. That's the power of filing one form on time.

punchline.text: File the 83(b) on day one. It may be the best $100 you ever spend.

quiz.question: What does the 83(b) election do?
options: Lets you pay tax on stock value at the grant date, not vesting date
